title: Combinational Grant Glitch on Priority Mask
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [GLITCH] gnt changed mid-cycle without posedge clk
rtl: assign gnt = req & ~((1 << last_gnt) - 1);  // Pure combinational — glitches on req transitions
expected_root_cause: The grant output is driven by a purely combinational assign statement with no clock edge, allowing it to glitch for fractions of a cycle whenever the request vector or last_gnt changes.
description: The grant output is combinationally derived from the request vector and mask, producing sub-cycle glitches that corrupt downstream handshakes.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [GLITCH] gnt changed mid-cycle without posedge clk
success_log: gnt stable and glitch-free; only transitions on posedge clk.
